requirements.statement: Status filtering works and default behavior remains unchanged.

source_evidence.quote: Add an optional status filter to list_tasks: all, open or done; preserve the default list and reject invalid status values.

argv: from task_list import list_tasks; items=[{'title':'First','status':'open'},{'title':'Second','status':'done'}]; assert list_tasks(items, status='open') == ['First']; assert list_tasks(items, status='done') == ['Second']
from task_list import list_tasks; assert list_tasks([{'title':'First','status':'open'},{'title':'Second','status':'done'}]) == ['First','Second']; assert list_tasks([]) == []
